issue.title: Update launch test mocks for origin argument
issue.description: On c2aec595c8, tests/test_partial_launch_cleanup.py::test_launch_query_rolls_back_partial_multi_prompt_launch fails because fail_launch lacks origin; tests/test_bead/test_cli_work_cleanup_confirm.py::test_yes_still_prompts_for_cleanup_but_skips_launch_prompt fails because _seed_live_collision mock lacks origin. Phase notes report 22 test_cli_work failures and 2 errors with the same clean-tree family. Update launch mocks across affected tests without weakening launch assertions, then run the family.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: Both representative nodes fail deterministically in focused serial runs on current clean HEAD with the same unexpected origin keyword TypeError.

issue.creation_reason: Phases sase-1ck.4.1.1 and sase-1ck.4.1.3 proposed clean-tree launch-family failures; current HEAD reproduces the stale mock signature after the origin argument landed in eaa4aa4aa7.

payload.description: checking whether pre-existing check failure is already tracked

payload.entry: Resolved by 8c38eb6a9a (fix(master-gate): 'Update stale origin-kwarg test fakes/assertions across launch seams').
